intro.title: Medina
intro.subtitle: AI order assistant for a pharmaceutical distributor's B2B portal
intro.footer: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon · everything shown was built during the hackathon, Oct 28 – Nov 4, 2026

intro.title: The problem
bullets: Pharmacies send orders as messages, photos of handwritten lists and Excel files in their own layout — in Russian and Kazakh, with typos
The portal accepts only a file with three text columns: barcode | product code | quantity
One bad row and the whole file is rejected — no row number, no reason

subtitles.text: A pharmacy uploads its own file to the portal…
…and gets “File upload error” — no row number, no reason
One click sends the same file to Medina
Medina checks every row: pack multiple, barcode check digit, text instead of a number, mismatched code, numbers instead of text
…and says how to fix each row
Medina lives in the corner of the portal — added with one <script> line
Cards show what it can do
A list with typos, the way pharmacies write it
Every line is matched to the catalog and checked: stock in the branch, pack multiple, expiry
Out of stock — a substitute with the same INN, form and strength; quantity recalculated to keep the same number of units
Overdue debt is flagged before upload, not after
A person confirms — Medina builds an .xls in the portal's exact format
We upload it through the regular order upload…
…and the portal accepts it. The portal places the order — Medina sends nothing
Items are in the cart
A photo of a handwritten list — via the paperclip
Muse Spark reads the handwriting, then the same catalog checks run
Not in the catalog? Marked “not recognized” — nothing invented
Interface and answers in English, Russian and Kazakh
Switch to Kazakh and type an order…
…the answer comes in Kazakh: same table, pack multiples, stock and the overdue-debt warning
“What should I reorder for the cold season?”
Suggestions from this pharmacy's history and season demand across all customers — with a reason for each item
Items missing in the branch come with an in-stock analog
In the catalog: “Temporarily out of stock”
“Show analogs” opens Medina
Only items in stock: same INN, form and strength first, then the longest shelf life

outro.title: How it works
bullets: Muse Spark via the Meta Model API with tool calling: catalog search, batches and stock, analogs, line checks, Excel and photo reading, file validation, reorder
Exact checks are plain, tested code; the model reads the mess and explains
Embeds into the existing PrestaShop portal with one <script> line
Medina never places orders and gives no medical advice — a person always confirms

metrics.label: missing items with an in-stock analog
quantities fixed to the pack multiple
file errors found with the row number
